newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for 482 bln lire of Italy 5-yr Btp.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for 482 bln lire of Italy 5-yr Btp.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for 74 billion lire of three-year and 482 billion of five year fixed-rate bonds (BTP) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 250 billion and 200 billion lire of paper offered respectively.

Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 4.879 trillion lire at the open auction for July 1, 1999 paper against 2.5 trillion lire worth on offer. The auction price was set at 100.95 from 100.35 at the previous three-year Btp sale on August 30.

At the earlier open auction of July 1, 2001 paper, the Treausry received bids for 5.278 trillion lire worth of Btps against 2.0 trillion on offer. The auction price was set at 100.20 from 99.00 at the previous five-year Btp sale on August 30. --Milan bureau +392 66129507
